item.title: Two insider cases we've recently closed
item.description:
📝 As a regulated exchange, we ban insider trading. So, we’re releasing information about two insider trading cases we’ve recently closed. The second concerns an insider who traded about $4,000 on YouTube streaming markets, a violation of Kalshi’s insider trading rules.
🔗 Read more: https://news.kalshi.com/p/kalshi-trading-violation-enforcement-cases
